2609.35551.title: BaRe-Mem: Bayesian Reliability Memory for Robust and Adaptive Agent Consultation
2609.35551.paper_summary: In multi-agent systems, reliable consultation is challenging because advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading information can make consultation worse than autonomous reasoning. We introduce BaRe-Mem, an online Bayesian reliability memory for multi-agent consultation. It estimates advisor reliability based on the central model's internal belief representations and updates these estimates from historical interactions. These estimates modulate the influence of advisor responses and guide the choice between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Across nine benchmarks and six central models, BaRe-Mem is more robust to misleading advisor information than debate and majority voting. On the more challenging tasks, it remains above autonomous reasoning across all tested misleading levels. Moreover, we extend the BaRe-Mem mechanism to worker allocation in agent teams. On the MuSiQue benchmark, BaRe-Mem improves task completion over routing by historical success counts and identifies capable workers earlier.
2609.35551.paper_summary_zh: 在多代理系統中，可靠的諮詢是具有挑戰性的，因為顧問的能力在不同任務中有所不同，而誤導性的信息可能使諮詢的效果比自主推理更糟。<lb/>我們介紹了BaRe-Mem，一種用於多代理諮詢的在線貝葉斯可靠性記憶。<lb/>它根據中央模型的內部信念表徵來估計顧問的可靠性，並從歷史互動中更新這些估計。<lb/>這些估計調節顧問回應的影響，並指導在諮詢和自主推理之間的選擇。<lb/>在九個基準和六個中央模型中，BaRe-Mem對誤導性顧問信息的抵抗力比辯論和多數投票更強。<lb/>在更具挑戰性的任務中，它在所有測試的誤導水平中仍然優於自主推理。<lb/>此外，我們將BaRe-Mem機制擴展到代理團隊中的工作分配。<lb/>在MuSiQue基準上，BaRe-Mem通過歷史成功次數改善了任務完成情況，並更早識別出有能力的工作者。
